articles.headline: Rodri says Spain's midfield tops Portugal's 'best generation' ahead of World Cup clash
articles.description: Captain Rodri has insisted that Spain's midfield is superior to Portugal's ahead of their World Cup round of 16 clash -- while admitting that their opponents' squad boasts "one of the best generations they've ever had."
